task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the glazed bowl with curved sides, stack it precisely on top of the ceramic bowl.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将弧形釉碗抬起，精确地堆叠在陶瓷碗的顶部。
